digest.component_or_area: op-cert signing and enforcement (MCP container + verify-opcert merge-gate)
propositions: The MCP container must be provisioned to sign op-certs (plan-review and completion-verifier) using the existing pinned environment 9f1c8e42-7a3b-4d5e-b6c1-2f0a9d8e7c65 by composing a signer binding from REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID and the materialized Ed25519 key at startup, routing both principal and key to the correct signing environment.

A container-minted op-cert must verify successfully against the pinned public key in .rebar/trusted_environments.yaml through the real verify_required_environment path, while an identical cert signed by an unregistered key must be rejected.

The enforce/grandfather mechanism must be testable against a fixture config with verify.require_environment and verify.opcert_enforce_since set jointly: closes after the boundary without a valid cert fail verify-opcert (exit 1, enforced) and pre-boundary closes are reported advisory (exit 0, grandfathered).

The authoritative enforcement flip (setting verify.require_environment and verify.opcert_enforce_since in rebar.toml) must be deferred to a human-run operator runbook and NOT committed in this stack to prevent retroactive merge-gate failures on local-CLI closes.
The solution must be fully additive and reversible with no new environment or key material created, and existing opcert-minted certs must continue to verify after the changes.
